// Sound Synthesizer via Web Audio API let audioCtx = null; let soundEnabled = true;
function playSound(type = 'click') { if (!soundEnabled) return; try { if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator(); const gain = audioCtx.createGain(); osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audioCtx.destination); const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
if (type === 'click') { osc.type = 'sine'; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, now); osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(850, now + 0.05); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.05); osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.05); } else if (type === 'launch') { osc.type = 'triangle'; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, now); osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(740, now + 0.12); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.12); osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.12); } else if (type === 'close') { osc.type = 'sine'; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(540, now); osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(260, now + 0.08); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.08); osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.08); } } catch (e) {} }
function toggleSound() { soundEnabled = !soundEnabled; const icon = document.getElementById('sound-icon'); if (icon) icon.textContent = soundEnabled ? '🔊' : '🔇'; playSound('click'); }
function toggleFullscreen() { playSound('click'); if (!document.fullscreenElement) { document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {}); } else { document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {}); } }
// Animated Starfield (function initStars() { const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas-stars'); if (!canvas) return; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); let w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth; let h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight; window.addEventListener('resize', () => { w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth; h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }); const stars = Array.from({ length: 85 }, () => ({ x: Math.random() * w, y: Math.random() * h, size: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.4, alpha: Math.random() * 0.8 + 0.2, speed: Math.random() * 0.015 + 0.005 })); function render() { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); for (const s of stars) { s.alpha += s.speed; if (s.alpha > 1 || s.alpha < 0.2) s.speed = -s.speed; ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.alpha))})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); } requestAnimationFrame(render); } render(); })();
// Digital Clock function updateClock() { const now = new Date(); let hours = now.getHours(); const minutes = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'); const seconds = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0'); const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'; hours = hours % 12 || 12; const timeStr = `${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds} ${ampm}`; const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); const tEl = document.getElementById('clock-time'); const dEl = document.getElementById('clock-date'); if (tEl) tEl.textContent = timeStr; if (dEl) dEl.textContent = dateStr; } setInterval(updateClock, 1000); updateClock();
const APP_ICONS = { p2p: "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,", arcade: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', quick: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', calculator: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', notes: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', terminal: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', themes: 'data:image/png;base64,', settings: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' };
// Window Manager State let highestZ = 100; const windows = new Map();
function bringToFront(winEl) { highestZ += 2; winEl.style.zIndex = highestZ; document.querySelectorAll('.os-window').forEach(w => w.classList.remove('active')); winEl.classList.remove('minimized'); winEl.classList.add('active'); updateDockWindows(); }
function toggleStartMenu() { playSound('click'); const menu = document.getElementById('start-menu'); if (menu) menu.classList.toggle('open'); }
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { const menu = document.getElementById('start-menu'); const startBtn = document.querySelector('.start-btn'); if (menu && menu.classList.contains('open')) { if (!menu.contains(e.target) && !startBtn.contains(e.target)) { menu.classList.remove('open'); } } });
function makeDraggable(winEl, headerEl) { let isDragging = false; let startX, startY, initialX, initialY;
headerEl.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { if (e.target.closest('.ctrl-btn') || winEl.dataset.maximized === 'true') return; isDragging = true; bringToFront(winEl); startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; const rect = winEl.getBoundingClientRect(); initialX = rect.left; initialY = rect.top;
function onMouseMove(moveEvent) { if (!isDragging) return; const dx = moveEvent.clientX - startX; const dy = moveEvent.clientY - startY; winEl.style.left = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 100, initialX + dx)) + 'px'; winEl.style.top = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, initialY + dy)) + 'px'; }
function onMouseUp() { isDragging = false; window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove); window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp); }
window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove); window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp); }); }
function createWindow({ id, title, icon, width = 880, height = 580, contentHtml, onInit }) { playSound('launch'); const container = document.getElementById('windows-container');
// If already exists, focus it if (windows.has(id)) { const existing = windows.get(id); bringToFront(existing.el); return existing; }
const winEl = document.createElement('div'); winEl.className = 'os-window active'; winEl.id = `win-${id}`; winEl.style.width = Math.min(width, window.innerWidth - 40) + 'px'; winEl.style.height = Math.min(height, window.innerHeight - 100) + 'px';
// Center window with slight offset const offset = (windows.size * 25) % 120; winEl.style.left = Math.max(20, (window.innerWidth - width) / 2 + offset) + 'px'; winEl.style.top = Math.max(30, (window.innerHeight - height) / 2 - 20 + offset) + 'px';
const isImgIcon = typeof icon === 'string' && (icon.startsWith('data:') || icon.startsWith('http') || icon.startsWith('/') || icon.startsWith('./')); const isSvgIcon = typeof icon === 'string' && (icon.startsWith('<svg') || icon.startsWith('<img')); const titleIconHtml = isImgIcon ? `` : (isSvgIcon ? icon : `${icon || '🎮'}`);
winEl.innerHTML = `
${titleIconHtml} ${title}
− □ ✕
${contentHtml}
`;
container.appendChild(winEl); bringToFront(winEl);
const header = winEl.querySelector('.window-header'); makeDraggable(winEl, header);
// Window Controls const closeBtn = winEl.querySelector('.ctrl-close'); const minBtn = winEl.querySelector('.ctrl-min'); const maxBtn = winEl.querySelector('.ctrl-max');
closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { playSound('close'); winEl.remove(); windows.delete(id); updateDockWindows(); });
minBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { playSound('click'); winEl.classList.add('minimized'); winEl.classList.remove('active'); updateDockWindows(); });
maxBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { playSound('click'); if (winEl.dataset.maximized === 'true') { winEl.dataset.maximized = 'false'; winEl.style.top = winEl.dataset.prevTop; winEl.style.left = winEl.dataset.prevLeft; winEl.style.width = winEl.dataset.prevWidth; winEl.style.height = winEl.dataset.prevHeight; winEl.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-lg)'; } else { winEl.dataset.maximized = 'true'; winEl.dataset.prevTop = winEl.style.top; winEl.dataset.prevLeft = winEl.style.left; winEl.dataset.prevWidth = winEl.style.width; winEl.dataset.prevHeight = winEl.style.height; winEl.style.top = '0px'; winEl.style.left = '0px'; winEl.style.width = '100vw'; winEl.style.height = 'calc(100vh - 72px)'; winEl.style.borderRadius = '0px'; } });
winEl.addEventListener('mousedown', () => bringToFront(winEl));
const winObj = { id, title, icon, el: winEl }; windows.set(id, winObj); updateDockWindows();
if (typeof onInit === 'function') onInit(winEl); return winObj; }
function updateDockWindows() { const dockList = document.getElementById('dock-windows'); if (!dockList) return; dockList.innerHTML = ''; windows.forEach((w) => { const item = document.createElement('div'); item.className = 'dock-window-item' + (w.el.classList.contains('active') && !w.el.classList.contains('minimized') ? ' active' : ''); item.innerHTML = `${w.icon.startsWith('data:') ? `` : `${w.icon}`}${w.title}`; item.onclick = () => { playSound('click'); if (w.el.classList.contains('minimized')) { w.el.classList.remove('minimized'); bringToFront(w.el); } else if (w.el.classList.contains('active')) { w.el.classList.add('minimized'); w.el.classList.remove('active'); updateDockWindows(); } else { bringToFront(w.el); } }; dockList.appendChild(item); }); }

function setCursor(cursorId) { playSound('click'); if (cursorId === 'default' || !cursorId) { document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-cursor'); localStorage.removeItem('godly_cursor'); } else { document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-cursor', cursorId); localStorage.setItem('godly_cursor', cursorId); } document.querySelectorAll('.cursor-pill').forEach(btn => { btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.cursor === cursorId); }); }
// Auto-restore cursor try { const savedCursor = localStorage.getItem('godly_cursor'); if (savedCursor) setCursor(savedCursor); } catch (e) {}
function setTheme(themeClass) { playSound('click'); document.body.className = themeClass; document.querySelectorAll('.theme-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active')); const activeCard = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.theme-card')).find(c => c.getAttribute('onclick').includes(themeClass)); if (activeCard) activeCard.classList.add('active'); }
function clearNotes() { playSound('click'); const ta = document.getElementById('notes-input'); if (ta) { ta.value = ''; localStorage.removeItem('godly_games_notes'); } }
// Calculator Logic let calcVal = '0'; let calcPendingOp = null; let calcPrevVal = null;
function calcAction(btn) { playSound('click'); const disp = document.getElementById('calc-display'); if (!disp) return;
if (btn === 'C') { calcVal = '0'; calcPendingOp = null; calcPrevVal = null; } else if (btn === '+/-') { calcVal = String(-parseFloat(calcVal)); } else if (btn === '%') { calcVal = String(parseFloat(calcVal) / 100); } else if (['+', '-', '*', '/'].includes(btn)) { calcPrevVal = parseFloat(calcVal); calcPendingOp = btn; calcVal = '0'; } else if (btn === '=') { if (calcPendingOp && calcPrevVal !== null) { const cur = parseFloat(calcVal); let res = 0; if (calcPendingOp === '+') res = calcPrevVal + cur; else if (calcPendingOp === '-') res = calcPrevVal - cur; else if (calcPendingOp === '*') res = calcPrevVal * cur; else if (calcPendingOp === '/') res = cur !== 0 ? calcPrevVal / cur : 'Error'; calcVal = String(res); calcPendingOp = null; calcPrevVal = null; } } else if (btn === '.') { if (!calcVal.includes('.')) calcVal += '.'; } else { if (calcVal === '0') calcVal = btn; else calcVal += btn; } disp.textContent = calcVal; }
// Terminal Logic function setupTerminal(winEl) { const input = winEl.querySelector('#term-input'); const output = winEl.querySelector('#term-output'); if (!input || !output) return;
input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { const cmd = input.value.trim(); input.value = ''; if (!cmd) return; printTerm(`godly@games:~$ ${cmd}`, 'color:#a855f7;'); handleTermCmd(cmd); output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight; } });
function printTerm(text, style = '') { const line = document.createElement('div'); line.style = style; line.innerHTML = text; output.appendChild(line); }
function handleTermCmd(cmd) { const [action, ...args] = cmd.split(' '); const argStr = args.join(' ').toLowerCase();
if (action === 'help') { printTerm('Available commands:'); printTerm(' games - Show total games count & category breakdown'); printTerm(' search <query> - Search games catalog'); printTerm(' play <query/random> - Launch a matching game in OS window'); printTerm(' theme <cosmic|aurora|cyberpunk|metal|emerald> - Switch theme'); printTerm(' neofetch - Display system architecture & info'); printTerm(' clear - Clear screen'); } else if (action === 'clear') { output.innerHTML = ''; } else if (action === 'games') { printTerm(`Total games registered: ${GAMES_DATA.length}`); printTerm(`• GN Math Engine: 840 games`); printTerm(`• Classic Retro Archive: 1,567 games`); } else if (action === 'search') { if (!argStr) return printTerm('Usage: search <title>'); const matches = GAMES_DATA.filter(g => g.title.toLowerCase().includes(argStr)).slice(0, 10); if (matches.length === 0) return printTerm('No games found matching: ' + argStr, 'color:#ef4444;'); printTerm(`Found ${matches.length} matches:`); matches.forEach(m => printTerm(`• ${m.title} [${m.category}] (ID: ${m.id})`)); } else if (action === 'play') { if (!argStr || argStr === 'random') { launchRandomGame(); printTerm('Launching random game...', 'color:#10b981;'); } else { const match = GAMES_DATA.find(g => g.title.toLowerCase().includes(argStr)); if (match) { launchGame(match); printTerm(`Launching: ${match.title}`, 'color:#10b981;'); } else { printTerm('No game found matching: ' + argStr, 'color:#ef4444;'); } } } else if (action === 'neofetch') { printTerm(`

`); } else if (action === 'theme') { if (argStr.includes('aurora')) setTheme('theme-aurora'); else if (argStr.includes('cyber')) setTheme('theme-cyberpunk'); else if (argStr.includes('metal')) setTheme('theme-liquid-metal'); else if (argStr.includes('emerald')) setTheme('theme-emerald'); else setTheme('theme-cosmic'); printTerm('Theme updated to: ' + argStr); } else { printTerm('Command not recognized: ' + action + '. // Arcade Setup & Rendering function setupArcade(winEl) { const searchInput = winEl.querySelector('#arcade-search'); const grid = winEl.querySelector('#arcade-grid'); const catPills = winEl.querySelectorAll('.cat-pill'); const pageInfo = winEl.querySelector('#arcade-page-info'); const btnPrev = winEl.querySelector('#btn-prev-page'); const btnNext = winEl.querySelector('#btn-next-page');
let currentCat = 'all'; let currentQuery = ''; let currentPage = 1; const pageSize = 48;
function getFilteredGames() { return GAMES_DATA.filter(g => { const matchesCat = currentCat === 'all' || (currentCat === 'GN Math' && g.category === 'GN Math') || (currentCat === 'Classic Retro' && g.category !== 'GN Math') || g.category.toLowerCase().includes(currentCat.toLowerCase()); const matchesQuery = !currentQuery || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(currentQuery) || (g.author && g.author.toLowerCase().includes(currentQuery)); return matchesCat && matchesQuery; }); }
function renderGrid() { const filtered = getFilteredGames(); const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / pageSize)); if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages; if (currentPage < 1) currentPage = 1;
const startIdx = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize; const pageItems = filtered.slice(startIdx, startIdx + pageSize);
pageInfo.textContent = `Showing ${startIdx + 1}–${Math.min(startIdx + pageSize, filtered.length)} of ${filtered.length.toLocaleString()} games (Page ${currentPage} of ${totalPages})`; btnPrev.disabled = currentPage <= 1; btnNext.disabled = currentPage >= totalPages;
grid.innerHTML = ''; if (pageItems.length === 0) { grid.innerHTML = '
No games found matching your search.'; return; }
pageItems.forEach(game => { const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'game-card';
let thumbHtml = ''; if (game.cover) { thumbHtml = `<img class="card-thumb" src="${game.cover}" loading="lazy" alt="${game.title}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.parentElement.innerHTML='
🎮';" />`; } else { const gradients = [ 'linear-gradient(135deg, #4f46e5, #06b6d4)', 'linear-gradient(135deg, #9333ea, #ec4899)', 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #0ea5e9)', 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #ef4444)' ]; const gIdx = Math.abs(game.title.charCodeAt(0) || 0) % gradients.length; thumbHtml = `
🎮`; }
card.innerHTML = `
${thumbHtml}
${game.category}
${game.title}
${game.author || 'Unblocked'} ▶ Play Game
`;
card.onclick = () => launchGame(game); grid.appendChild(card); }); }
searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => { currentQuery = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim(); currentPage = 1; renderGrid(); });
catPills.forEach(pill => { pill.addEventListener('click', () => { playSound('click'); catPills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active')); pill.classList.add('active'); currentCat = pill.dataset.cat; currentPage = 1; renderGrid(); }); });
btnPrev.addEventListener('click', () => { if (currentPage > 1) { playSound('click'); currentPage--; renderGrid(); winEl.querySelector('.arcade-grid-wrap').scrollTop = 0; } });
btnNext.addEventListener('click', () => { playSound('click'); currentPage++; renderGrid(); winEl.querySelector('.arcade-grid-wrap').scrollTop = 0; });
renderGrid(); }
// Launch Game in its own OS Window function launchGame(game) { const winId = `game-${game.id}`; let targetUrl = game.url; if (targetUrl.includes('donoEla/Godly-OS-Workspac---Github@main/local-games/')) { targetUrl = targetUrl.replace('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/donoEla/Godly-OS-Workspac---Github@main/local-games/', 'https://donoela.github.io/Godly-OS-Workspac---Github/local-games/'); }
createWindow({ id: winId, title: game.title, icon: APP_ICONS.arcade, width: 1020, height: 660, contentHtml: `
${game.title} [${game.category}]
↻ Reload ⛶ Fullscreen ↗ External Tab
`, onInit: (winEl) => { const frame = winEl.querySelector(`#frame-${winId}`); if (frame) { loadGameIntoFrame(frame, targetUrl); } } }); }
async function loadGameIntoFrame(frame, rawUrl) { if (!frame) return; let targetUrl = rawUrl; if (targetUrl.includes('donoEla/Godly-OS-Workspac---Github@main/local-games/')) { targetUrl = targetUrl.replace('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/donoEla/Godly-OS-Workspac---Github@main/local-games/', 'https://donoela.github.io/Godly-OS-Workspac---Github/local-games/'); }
frame.dataset.gameUrl = targetUrl;
// GitHub Pages directly serves full text/html and allows iframes if (targetUrl.includes('donoela.github.io')) { frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc'); frame.src = targetUrl; return; }
// For jsDelivr / CDN links serving text/plain causing browser nosniff blocks: try { const res = await fetch(targetUrl); if (res.ok) { let html = await res.text(); if (html && html.trim().length > 0 && !html.includes('404: Not Found') && !html.includes('Failed to resolve')) { const baseHref = targetUrl.substring(0, targetUrl.lastIndexOf('/') + 1); if (!html.toLowerCase().includes('<base ') && !html.toLowerCase().includes('<base=')) { if (html.toLowerCase().includes('
')) { html = html.replace(/
/i, `
\n`); } else { html = `\n` + html; } } frame.srcdoc = html; return; } } } catch (err) { console.warn('Game fetch srcdoc error, falling back to direct src:', err); }
frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc'); frame.src = targetUrl; }
function reloadP2PFrame() { playSound('click'); const frame = document.getElementById('frame-p2p'); if (frame) { frame.srcdoc = ''; setTimeout(() => { frame.srcdoc = P2P_LOADER_HTML; }, 50); } }
function fullscreenP2PFrame() { playSound('click'); const frame = document.getElementById('frame-p2p'); if (frame) { if (frame.requestFullscreen) frame.requestFullscreen(); else if (frame.webkitRequestFullscreen) frame.webkitRequestFullscreen(); } }
function reloadGameFrame(winId, url) { playSound('click'); const frame = document.getElementById(`frame-${winId}`); if (frame) { const targetUrl = url || frame.dataset.gameUrl || frame.src; if (targetUrl) { loadGameIntoFrame(frame, targetUrl); } else { frame.contentWindow?.location.reload(); } } }
function fullscreenGameFrame(winId) { playSound('click'); const frame = document.getElementById(`frame-${winId}`); if (frame) { if (frame.requestFullscreen) frame.requestFullscreen(); else if (frame.webkitRequestFullscreen) frame.webkitRequestFullscreen(); } }
function launchRandomGame() { if (GAMES_DATA.length === 0) return; const randIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * GAMES_DATA.length); const randGame = GAMES_DATA[randIdx]; launchGame(randGame); }
// Auto launch Arcade on initial boot window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { setTimeout(() => { openApp('arcade'); }, 300); });
// High-Performance Analog Chronometer Canvas Engine (function initWidgetClock() { const canvas = document.getElementById('clock-canvas'); if (!canvas) return; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const digiTime = document.getElementById('widget-clock-digi'); const digiDate = document.getElementById('widget-clock-date'); const tzBadge = document.getElementById('widget-tz');
try { const tzName = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone.split('/').pop().replace(/_/g, ' '); if (tzBadge) tzBadge.textContent = tzName.toUpperCase(); } catch (e) {}
let lastSec = -1;
function renderClock() { const now = new Date(); const cx = canvas.width / 2; const cy = canvas.height / 2; const r = cx - 3;
ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
// Luminous dial background const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 2, cx, cy, r); grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.22)'); grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)'); ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
// Rim ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.stroke();
// Ticks for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 6; const isMajor = i % 3 === 0; const innerR = isMajor ? r - 5 : r - 2.5; ctx.strokeStyle = isMajor ? '#c084fc' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = isMajor ? 1.8 : 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(angle) * innerR, cy + Math.sin(angle) * innerR); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(angle) * r, cy + Math.sin(angle) * r); ctx.stroke(); }
const ms = now.getMilliseconds(); const s = now.getSeconds() + ms / 1000; const m = now.getMinutes() + s / 60; const h = (now.getHours() % 12) + m / 60;
// Hour hand const hAngle = (h * Math.PI) / 6 - Math.PI / 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(hAngle) * (r * 0.5), cy + Math.sin(hAngle) * (r * 0.5)); ctx.stroke();
// Minute hand const mAngle = (m * Math.PI) / 30 - Math.PI / 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#c084fc'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.8; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(mAngle) * (r * 0.72), cy + Math.sin(mAngle) * (r * 0.72)); ctx.stroke();
// Second hand const sAngle = (s * Math.PI) / 30 - Math.PI / 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - Math.cos(sAngle) * (r * 0.2), cy - Math.sin(sAngle) * (r * 0.2)); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(sAngle) * (r * 0.85), cy + Math.sin(sAngle) * (r * 0.85)); ctx.stroke();
// Center pivot ctx.fillStyle = '#a855f7'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
// Update digital readout on full second const curSec = now.getSeconds(); if (curSec !== lastSec) { lastSec = curSec; if (digiTime) digiTime.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }); if (digiDate) digiDate.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); }
requestAnimationFrame(renderClock); } renderClock(); })();
// Real-Time System HUD Wave Engine (function initSystemTelemetry() { const poly = document.getElementById('sys-wave-poly'); const line = document.getElementById('sys-wave-line'); const badge = document.getElementById('widget-jit-badge'); const cpuBar = document.getElementById('metric-cpu-fill'); const ramBar = document.getElementById('metric-ram-fill');
const history = [18, 22, 19, 26, 24, 20, 29, 25, 32, 22, 27, 21];
function updateTelemetry() { const newCpu = Math.floor(12 + Math.random() * 26); history.shift(); history.push(newCpu);
if (badge) badge.textContent = `${newCpu}% JIT`; if (cpuBar) cpuBar.style.width = `${newCpu}%`;
let mem = 38 + Math.round(Math.random() * 8); const perfMem = window.performance && window.performance.memory; if (perfMem) mem = Math.round((perfMem.usedJSHeapSize / perfMem.jsHeapSizeLimit) * 100); if (ramBar) ramBar.style.width = `${mem}%`;
const points = history.map((val, idx) => { const x = (idx / (history.length - 1)) * 200; const y = 28 - (val / 100) * 24; return `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`; }).join(' ');
if (line) line.setAttribute('points', points); if (poly) poly.setAttribute('points', `0,28 ${points} 200,28`); }
setInterval(updateTelemetry, 2200); updateTelemetry(); })();
